[NSTG.3.2.1] **Success is silence; a lost write is a `CallError`.**
`record_fact` declares `no response` ([LSTO.13.1]): the callback returns
`DS_OK` and asserts nothing for a write it makes durable. For a write it cannot
make durable it must assert a `CallError` carrying the call's correlation,
whenever it learns of the failure ([LSTO.2.4.1], [LCRS.17.1]).
